purpose: v5 automatic swing-up at 40%, swingup-calibrated-01 (model calibrated to swing-621/631/641).

sources.algorithm_id: v4 isolated logic default; not a powered qualification
sources.keepalive_ms: 200 ms board watchdog with 50 ms host keepalive
sources.travel_limit_count: 200 count (~69 deg) from the CONFIG-time arm position; user confirmed >=90 deg cable clearance each side from centre
sources.speed_limit_count_s: 5000 count/s, about half the datasheet no-load speed; balance sims stay far below
sources.adc_speed_limit_code_s: 10000 code/s (~60 rad/s) only trips on a fall or sensor fault
sources.max_compare: 1000/2500 = 40%: design ceiling; design C sweep at 40% saturates <=6.6% of the time
sources.hold_ms: 200 ms (101 snapshots) inside the entry window before takeover
sources.upright_zero_q16: 737 code: balance-451 held the pendulum 12.5 s with mean ADC 734+2.6 (mean arm offset -32 count consistent with a +2.6 code zero error)
sources.enter_code: 8 code entry window (~2.4-2.8 deg), as in the board checks
sources.exit_code: 80 codes: room for a catch at 21.46556767079009 deg
sources.comp_compare: 175 = 7% kinetic friction compensation, design A (identified d0 6.7%/7.6%)
sources.blend_compare: 62/2500 = 2.48%: 4% comp (501) cut chatter but let the arm wander 3x; 10% (492) added chatter
sources.comp_gain_q20: nearest Q20 of 175/62, firmware slope check
sources.coefficients: design D: q=(300.0, 200.0, 20.0, 5.0), r=0.5, qw=(10.0, 6.0); chosen under backlash 10-14, noise 1.5, ADC scale 1.2 realistic cases (2026-10-18)
sources.sample_period_us: v4 isolated logic default; not a powered qualification
